Config.Description: A Flask web UI and JSON API for text-to-image generation with the GGUF quantizations of Qwen-Image 2.1, driving a running ComfyUI backend.
Config.Example: a watercolour lighthouse on a rocky coast at dusk

Functionalities.Name: Text-to-image generation
Functionalities.Description: Enter a prompt and parameters (resolution, steps, CFG, seed, batch) and the server queues the Qwen-Image 2.1 GGUF workflow on ComfyUI, waits for the render and returns the images in the browser and to the output/ directory.

Functionalities.Name: Model and quantization switching
Functionalities.Description: Pick any published GGUF quantization (Q4_0 through BF16) and either text encoder (int8 or bf16) per request without editing the workflow.

Functionalities.Name: JSON API
Functionalities.Description: POST /api/generate with a JSON body to script generation; GET /api/health reports whether the ComfyUI backend is reachable.
